fields.label: HER2 IHC (ToGA / CAP gastric criteria)
options: Score 3+ (Positive — strong complete/basolateral/lateral in >= 10% resection or >= 5-cell cluster biopsy)

reference.title: Gastric / GEJ biomarker panel (HER2, PD-L1 CPS, CLDN18.2, MMR, EBER)
reference.intro: Gastric HER2 uses distinct biopsy (>= 5 cohesive tumour cells) vs resection (>= 10% tumour cells) thresholds and includes basolateral/lateral U-shaped staining. CLDN18.2 positivity requires >= 75% tumour cells with moderate-to-strong (2+/3+) membranous staining.
reference.note: Photomicrographs are from Wikimedia Commons under open Creative Commons licences. ExpertPath pages open with your own ExpertPath login; the app holds none of their images.

groups.heading: Gastric predictive biomarker thresholds & staining patterns
points: PD-L1 (22C3 / 28-8): report exact Combined Positive Score (CPS = [PD-L1+ tumour cells + lymphocytes + macrophages] / total viable tumour cells x 100, capped at 100).
CLDN18.2 (43-14A): positive if >= 75% of viable tumour cells show 2+/3+ membranous staining.
